citations.assessment: This passage calls the speaker Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yannai.
The speaker bears the same patronym.
Rabbi Dostai son of Rabbi Yannai transmits in Rabbi Meir’s name. Heilprin expressly infers studenthood.
The Mishnah as printed on the daf expressly transmits this ruling through Dostai in Rabbi Meir’s name.
The opening gives the patronym and Rabbi Meir among the attributions. A subsequent phrase resumes with Rabbi Dostai transmitting in Rabbi Meir’s name.
The parallel explicitly carries the chain Dostai in the name of Yannai in the name of Meir. Its status as a copying error is Heilprin’s judgment.

The continuation names the two emissaries. The first part on 14a names Rabbi Achi son of Rabbi Yoshiyah and speaks of a deposit of money; retain Heilprin’s description of collecting a debt and compare the debt wording in the Yerushalmi.
The two named men go to collect a debt in this version.
